topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: When I arrived home, there on the doorstep were flowers—vibrant and neatly arranged in a clear vase. No card, no note, just the silence of the hallway echoing as I stepped inside. I examined the bouquet, trying to connect the vibrant colors, the delicate petals, to someone, anyone. But my mind raced with faces that didn’t fit, messages unspoken. I placed the vase on the table, the water clear and still, the air around me growing heavier. Each petal seemed to whisper, but I couldn’t discern the words. The phone lay untouched beside me, the silence now louder, urging me to call, to ask, but to whom?
